key_result: Prior unsold prize amounts may fund up to EUR 11m of the already-fixed category-1/2 awards; they do not increase the stated prizes.
status: CLOSED for additive-rollover subsidy; no guaranteed-profit result
notes: 2026 category 1 is fixed at EUR 11m and category 2 at eleven EUR 1m prizes before paragraph 3.4 describes source funding.
Paragraph 3.4 permits up to EUR 11m of those fixed amounts to come from prior unsold prizes; it does not add EUR 11m on top.
The 120-series screen calibrates against official 2024/2025 issuance and is not a claim that the 2026 Q4 series count has already been published.
Collision-free lower-category arithmetic is an upper bound because non-category-1/2 prizes are non-accumulable.
